intent: One announcer for a whole application: a single ToastRegion holding visible toasts and speech-only Announcements, each routed by politeness rather than by tone. For an application that owns exactly two live regions and lets nothing else write one. For a single confirmation toast, use action-feedback.

parameters.ask: Should the outcome of the user's own action interrupt, success included?

content.outcome: [the outcome of the action the user just took]
content.state-change: [a change to the object on screen, spoken and not shown]
content.field-errors: [how many fields need attention, spoken after a failed submission]
